To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marek, I would like to ask you to reconsider the proposed lineup before the names are submitted on Friday, 13 November. I do not agree with placing Liliana as reserve on the basis of the November rating list alone.

In your post of 1 October, you stated that selection would take account of both the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. You also stated that the players’ coaches would be consulted before the final lineup. As Liliana’s coach, I was not consulted before this lineup was posted, and I would appreciate the opportunity to give my assessment before the decision is finalised.

At the qualifier, Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, behind Kacper. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper; Igor finished fourth with 4/7. These results deserve meaningful consideration under the criteria announced in October.

The November list puts Igor at 1874 and Liliana at 1851. However, as noted when the list was shared, Liliana’s 81-point loss came entirely from the Katowice open in early October. She played all her games there while affected by health reasons, and I do not consider that result representative of her current playing strength. She subsequently missed approximately two weeks of training for health reasons. She is now back to her normal level, and her last three lessons have been very good.

This is not an objection to Igor personally. I respect him and his progress. My concern is that the selection should consistently reflect both announced criteria and include the promised consultation.

I am asking that Liliana be placed on board 2. Alternatively, I would accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday as a practical way to resolve the selection. Please confirm that we can review the lineup before it is submitted.
